HSC – Green Park Matric Hr Sec School || 90.5% 2022-2024 
SSLC – SKV Matric Hr Sec School || 96.2% 2021-2022 
 
INTERSHIP 
MERN Stack Intern – Better Tomorrow 
Completed an internship focused on MERN stack development using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. During the 
internship, developed web applications implementing REST APIs and CRUD operations. Worked on frontend development 
using React.js and built backend services using Node.js and Express.js. Also integrated MongoDB for efficient data storage, 
retrieval, and management within the application. 
 
 
Electricity Consumption Prediction System (Machine Learning | Python | Streamlit | Sklearn) 
Developed an end-to-end ML application to predict monthly electricity consumption across regions and consumer types, with 
preprocessing pipelines, feature engineering, and models like Linear Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost. Integrated 
weather and calendar data to boost accuracy, built a Streamlit interface for single/batch predictions and visual analytics, and 
delivered a deployable system for reliable, region-specific forecasts. 
Secure File Vault System (Java | JavaFX | AES | File Security) 
Developed a secure desktop application for protecting sensitive files using AES -based encryption and decryption, ensuring 
data confidentiality and integrity. Implemented user authentication, password hashing, and role -based access to restrict 
unauthorized usage. Designed an intuitive JavaFX UI for file upload, encryption, decryption, and access control, with 
structured file handling and error management. Delivered a robust and user-friendly system for secure file storage and retrieval. 
Hostel Management System(MongoDB | Express.js | ReactJS | Node.js) 
Developed a full -stack hostel management platform to manage student records, room allocations, and hostel operations. 
Implemented role -based access for admins and students, online complaint registration, and room availability tracking. 
Designed REST APIs for backend services and integrated a responsive React frontend for seamless management. 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
C Training | IIT Bombay 
Data Structures and Algorithms using C and C++ | Udemy 
Java certification | Oracle 
 
ACHIEVEMENTS

Selected among Top 60 teams in Kurukshetra Technovation, conducted by Anna University, Chennai.
